theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: KKR Commercial Real Estate Lender Studies Potential Sale, Merger
top_news.summary: A commercial real estate lender managed by KKR & Co. said it’s considering strategic alternatives that could include a merger or sale of the money-losing company.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 22
top_news.summary: Oil edged higher after President Donald Trump played down the prospect of near-term talks with Iran while threatening further strikes, as risks to global supply spread beyond the Middle East to the Black Sea.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set for Gains as Chipmakers Rebound: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks in Asia were set to gain on Wednesday as a rebound in chipmakers at the center of the artificial intelligence boom offset concerns over the renewed escalation in the US-Iran conflict.

top_news.title: Hong Kong Home Prices Set for 19% Rebound Over Two Years: BI
top_news.summary: Hong Kong home prices are expected to rebound the most in nearly a decade in 2026, driven by strong mainland Chinese demand, limited supply and robust rental growth, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.

top_news.title: Moody’s Lifts Argentina Debt Rating in Fresh Boost to Milei
top_news.summary: Moody’s Ratings upgraded Argentina’s credit score, giving the nation its third sovereign upgrade in less than three months and further validating President Javier Milei’s economic overhaul plan.

top_news.title: This ETF Tax Loophole Is All the Rage Among Rich Americans
top_news.summary: A bespoke fund is becoming a must-have tool for wealthy investors looking to defer — and sometimes even avoid — capital gains tax.

top_news.title: Stocks Climb as Rebound in Chipmakers Gathers Pace: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street staged a comeback as dip buyers emerged, boosting stocks amid a rally in chipmakers on bets the artificial-intelligence trade that’s powered the bull market has more room to run.

top_news.title: Nasdaq 100 Notches Best Day in Weeks as Chipmakers Rebound
top_news.summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index posted its best day in three weeks on Tuesday as a rebound in chipmakers at the center of the artificial-intelligence trade overshadowed the re-escalation in the US-Iran war.

top_news.title: Capital One Profit Beats Estimates as Loan-Loss Provisions Drop
top_news.summary: Capital One Financial Corp., the biggest US credit-card lender, swung to a profit in the second quarter as it set aside less money to cover bad loans than Wall Street had anticipated.

top_news.title: Canadian Stocks Climb as Gold Surge Offsets Trump Tariff Threat
top_news.summary: Canadian stocks climbed Tuesday despite US President Donald Trump threatening 50% tariffs on the country’s exports, thanks to surging gold prices and a rally in tech hardware stocks.
